scientific_integrity.computational_basis: Finite exact rational grounded-matrix inversions, 4700 cases, as supplementary tests.
scientific_integrity.independence: No independent scientific audit or certification is represented.
scientific_integrity.mathematical_basis: Exact two-terminal resistance formula on trees, exhaustive eight-orbit calculation and strict symbolic comparisons.

scientific_limitations: Only trees with two hubs, at least two leaves at each hub, common unit leaf-edge resistance and one positive bridge resistance are covered.
Exactly two noise-free leaders are optimized for trace of the grounded Laplacian inverse; other dynamics or objectives are not covered.
An unindexed equivalent classification could remain in the specialized literature; independent review has not been performed.
title: Exact two-leader coherence transition on weighted double stars
